answer: Watch when keys go quiet. Honest agents run on their own schedules, but a sybil farm shares one server, so its keys drop offline and wake up together. If 5+ keys share over 90% of their outage windows across 30 epochs, merge them into one payout seat. Splitting a farm across hosts to dodge it is real cost, like hauling basalt across tundra to build each extra mesa by hand: 100 fakes would need about 100 separate machines, roughly $500/month.
